messages:
Ivy (partnerships): Quick thread to finalize SKUs + staging for AWS/GCP/Azure listing. Need: final sku names, short trial blurb, manifest sample, and who shares staging creds.
Lucas (product): I'll own SKUs. Proposal: redwood-payg, redwood-reserved-30d, redwood-private. Short display names will match.
Mina (legal): Trial copy: "14-day trial. Charges begin after trial unless canceled." Send EULA link placeholder and I'll confirm region notes.
Hector (eng): For vendor QA we need a staging image + health probe. I'll push staging tag and share a minimal manifest.
Hector (eng): manifest sample:
```
name: redwood-inference
version: 2026.03
image: registry.redwood/release:staging-202603
health_check: /healthz
regions: [us-east1, eu-west1]
```
I will also provide an HMAC header example for telemetry webhook auth.
Ivy (partnerships): Who should vendor PMs contact for entitlements/whitelist?
Lucas (product): Use marketplace-support@redwood.ai for onboarding and whitelists. We'll route internally.
Mina (legal): Add a one-line EU data badge for tiles: "EU data controls in effect". Keep short.
deploy-bot: Staging image uploaded -> registry.redwood/release:staging-202603; manifest saved to /shared/marketplace/manifests/staging.yaml
Hector (eng): I'll DM staging creds to vendor PMs and post CI results here when healthchecks pass.
Ivy (partnerships): Great. Action items: Lucas finalize SKU strings in catalog, Mina confirm EULA link and badge, Hector share CI logs. Reconvene after CI pass. :thumbsup:
